author: /root/sizing_locales_b
qualification: Independent multilingual model language review by an agent that did not author this locale candidate. Not a native-human certification.

language_review.assessment: Read all 24 blocks. German uses clear formal address and preserves exact-product sizing, Körper- versus Kleidungsmaße, separate wearer variants, uncertain delivery estimates, garment-label guidance and the specific unresolved Meow units. No blanket availability or compliance assertion is added.
semantic_checks: Introduction preserves who is being bought for, design-specific offered sizes and selection inclusions; a multi-person photo does not prove a bundle.
All six ordered steps retain every wearer, each current product-specific size, included pieces/options, materials and care, gift timing, and return terms.
Sizing distinguishes units from measurement type and retains both body and garment measurement possibilities without inferring which the chart provides.
The Meow bullet explicitly says its chart unit labels need clarification and requires contact to confirm both units and body-versus-garment figures before choosing size.
Separate options where required, cart item names, sizes and quantities are all retained; no whole-family bundle is inferred.
Both proper product-name bases and translated short-/long-sleeve descriptors are retained; examples do not promise all sizes or availability.
Peter Rabbit uses its own measurements and product details, with no transfer of size from another design.
Unknown size remains a reason to confirm measurements with the recipient or child parent; age and usual size are only starting points.
Child sleepwear retains appropriate size, safety label and intended fit, the qualified oversized loose cotton hazard, no automatic size-up, and no category-based compliance proof.
No material, fiber, sleeping suitability, predictable shrinkage, shared care, delivery guarantee or return entitlement is invented.
Care follows the garment label for washing, drying and ironing; occasion planning retains coordination and checking everyone before an event-date order.
The closing shopping instruction retains per-wearer checklist and size, included-piece and quantity verification before adding selections.
language_review.specific_meow_clarification: Die Einheitenangaben in dieser Tabelle müssen geklärt werden. Kontaktieren Sie uns vor der Größenwahl, um die Einheiten zu bestätigen und zu klären, ob es sich bei den Zahlen um Körper- oder Kleidungsmaße handelt.

limits: Pass applies only to the exact English V2, candidate and input hashes recorded here; subsequent content changes require review again.
Source-fidelity review of supplied safety wording only; no independent legal, safety or product-compliance certification.
Meow chart unit labels and body-versus-garment interpretation remain unresolved; the faithful contact-before-sizing callout is not a product-data correction.
Eight href strings are checked against the supplied English and saved locale route observations. No live navigation, checkout, availability or delivery verification was performed by this reviewer.
Arabic RTL applies only to this stored article-body wrapper. No whole-page theme or rendered layout certification.
Publication, fresh source and external-state drift guards, preservation of unrelated fields and after-state readback remain root-owned.
